scope: actual index.html browser reporter path only; no gameplay, deployment, FLR_TEST, STEP79, or USER_FAIL_OPEN mutation

boundedness: only current or already-captured scene evidence

acceptance.current: A current report has the exact deterministic build ID, the actual DOM script chain equals the authoritative chain, each manifest-covered loaded source hash equals its expected SHA-256, and futureOutcomePrecomputed is false.
acceptance.staleOrMismatched: A stale build label, stale manifest ID/hash, script-chain difference, or any covered source hash mismatch is explicitly non-current.
acceptance.legacy: A payload without the V42 identity envelope is LEGACY_NOT_LOADED and is never promoted to current by a label alone.
acceptance.ambiguous: Capture/hash availability failure or incomplete required evidence is AMBIGUOUS, never CURRENT_MATCH.

knownLossPointsBeforeV42: normal scene payload used build TT-0.52 while compact summary used b TT-0.51
forced and UI-only payloads used unrelated FINAL-MATCH labels
Worker safeBuild stored client build labels without authoritative source validation
V42 validation manifest omitted reporter/config/controller/UI sources
413 metadata fallback could retain only unbound summary metadata
